description.en: A push button switches the lights on, after a set time they go off again. Pressing it again while they are on starts the time anew.
description.de: Ein Taster schaltet die Lampen ein, nach einer eingestellten Zeit gehen sie wieder aus. Ein erneuter Druck, während sie an sind, startet die Zeit neu.

author: GermanBluefox

description.en: For dimmers that have no state of their own to switch them on.
description.de: Für Dimmer, die keinen eigenen Datenpunkt zum Einschalten haben.

blockly:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <variables>
    <variable type="timeout" id="offTimer">offTimer</variable>
  </variables>
  <block type="on" x="10" y="10">
    <field name="OID">{{#if button.type == "buttonSensor"}}{{button.PRESS}}{{else}}{{button.SET}}{{/if}}</field>
    <field name="CONDITION">true</field>
    <field name="ACK_CONDITION"></field>
    <statement name="STATEMENT">
      <block type="timeouts_cleartimeout">
        <field name="NAME">offTimer</field>
        <next>
          <block type="timeouts_settimeout">
            <field name="NAME">offTimer</field>
            <field name="DELAY">{{duration}}</field>
            <field name="UNIT">sec</field>
            <statement name="STATEMENT">
{{#each light}}
{{#if light.ON_SET}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{light.ON_SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="logic_boolean">
                    <field name="BOOL">FALSE</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{else}}
{{#if light.type == "dimmer"}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{light.SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="math_number">
                    <field name="NUM">0</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{else}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{light.SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="logic_boolean">
                    <field name="BOOL">FALSE</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{/if}}
{{/if}}
{{/each}}
            </statement>
            <next>
{{#each light}}
{{#if light.ON_SET}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{light.ON_SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="logic_boolean">
                    <field name="BOOL">TRUE</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{else}}
{{#if light.type == "dimmer"}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{light.SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="math_number">
                    <field name="NUM">{{level}}</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{else}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{light.SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="logic_boolean">
                    <field name="BOOL">TRUE</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{/if}}
{{/if}}
{{/each}}
            </next>
          </block>
        </next>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>
